questions.title: Who will win the 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District?
questions.background: Andy Ogles has represented Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Tennessee election results, with a definitive Associated Press race call accepted before certification. Resolution Event : The determination of the winner of the Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District scheduled for August 6, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate’s full name.

questions.title: Which major US employment sector will shed the most jobs in July 2026?
questions.background: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reports monthly changes in nonfarm payroll employment by sector.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the broad employment sector with the largest net decline in payroll jobs in July 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics' initial employment report for that month, released in August 2026. Resolution Date : 2026-08-07 Accepted Answer Format : Compare sectors by the number of jobs lost, not percentage changes, and count subsectors within their parent sectors. Answer with the sector's name.

questions.title: Who will win the Republican primary for Alabama's 2nd Congressional District on August 11, 2026?
questions.background: The primary will determine the Republican nominee for this U.S. House seat in the November 2026 general election.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Associated Press's results and reporting for Alabama's August 11, 2026 Republican primary in the 2nd Congressional District. Resolution : Resolve when AP identifies the candidate who has secured the nomination. A preliminary lead or advancement to a runoff does not count as winning the nomination. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 Republican U.S. House primary featuring Florida incumbent Cory Mills?
questions.background: Cory Mills is seeking a third term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Florida Division of Elections results or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the primary winner. Resolution : Resolve to the winner of the Florida Republican U.S. House primary in which Cory Mills is a candidate, scheduled for August 18, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will win Florida's 2026 Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate special election?
questions.background: Florida is holding a special election to complete the U.S. Senate term vacated by Marco Rubio after he became secretary of state.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Florida Division of Elections results or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the primary winner. Resolution : Resolve to the winner of Florida's Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate special election, scheduled for August 18, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will President Donald Trump nominate in 2026 to succeed Marty Makary as FDA commissioner?
questions.background: Marty Makary resigned as commissioner of the US Food and Drug Administration in May 2026, leaving the position vacant. The president nominates the commissioner, subject to Senate confirmation.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official presidential announcement or reliable news reporting directly quoting that announcement. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the first person President Trump publicly announces as his nominee for FDA commissioner after Makary’s May 2026 resignation and before the end of 2026. The nomination announcement is sufficient; Senate confirmation is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The nominee’s full name.

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 special election for California's 14th congressional district?
questions.background: A special election will fill the U.S. House vacancy created by Eric Swalwell's resignation in April 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Consistent winner projections reported by major U.S. news organizations based on special-election results. Resolution Event : Resolve when a winner is publicly projected for the special election to complete Swalwell's unexpired term. The November 2026 election for the following full term does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Which Republican U.S. Senate candidate will be reported by August 25, 2026, to have asked AIPAC not to campaign on their behalf?
questions.background: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) is a pro-Israel lobbying organization active in congressional elections. Its political support has historically extended to candidates from both major U.S. parties. The next midterm elections are scheduled for November 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Reporting by established news organizations published by August 25, 2026. Resolution Conditions : Identify the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in the November 2026 election reported to have requested that AIPAC not run a campaign on their behalf. A request conveyed through the candidate's campaign allies qualifies; merely criticizing AIPAC does not. Accepted Answer Format : The candidate's first and last name.

questions.title: Which senior Trump administration official will CBS News report as visiting Moscow in August 2026?
questions.background: The United States has pursued diplomatic engagement with Russia concerning the war in Ukraine.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : CBS News reporting published during August 2026 identifying a senior Trump administration official as visiting Moscow. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the official explicitly named in that reporting as being in Moscow, rather than merely considering or planning a visit. The question concerns the identity reported by CBS News; independent verification or government confirmation of the visit is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The official's full name.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will report the country's first measles death of 2026?
questions.background: Measles can cause fatal complications, and state health departments monitor and report deaths associated with the disease.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official state health department announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the state that publicly reports a measles death among its residents occurring in calendar year 2026 and identified as the first reported U.S. measles fatality of that year. Resolution occurs when that announcement is made. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state.

questions.title: Which state will MAGA Inc. target with its first major general-election advertising buy of the 2026 midterms?
questions.background: MAGA Inc. is a super PAC associated with Donald Trump. Its advertising commitments can indicate which congressional races Republicans consider strategically important.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : MAGA Inc.'s public announcement and corresponding Federal Election Commission filing, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Rule : Resolve to the state targeted by the advertising commitment identified as MAGA Inc.'s first major general-election advertising expenditure of the 2026 midterm cycle. Resolution occurs when the commitment is publicly announced, regardless of when the advertisements begin running. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state where the advertisements are scheduled to run.

questions.title: Which Brazilian Supreme Court justice, if any, will order Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues suspended during September 2026?
questions.background: Brazil’s Federal Police investigates federal crimes, and its leadership can be subject to judicial orders.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public orders from Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the justice responsible. Resolution Conditions : Identify the justice who issues an order during September 2026 suspending Andrei Rodrigues from his position as Federal Police chief. If multiple qualifying orders are issued, use the earliest publicly announced order. Accepted Answer Format : The justice’s full name. If no qualifying order is issued by September 30, 2026, answer “None”.

questions.title: What immigration status will the Trump administration seek to require for noncitizens to be included in the 2030 US census?
questions.background: The decennial US census affects representation in the House of Representatives and the allocation of federal funding. Trump has previously advocated changing which immigrants are counted.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Department of Commerce proposal, or reliable contemporaneous reporting explicitly describing its eligibility rules for the 2030 census. Resolution Conditions : Resolve upon the administration's next formal proposal specifying eligibility for the 2030 census, provided it is published by September 30, 2026. Identify the immigration status the proposal requires noncitizens to hold to be included. Publication is sufficient; implementation or judicial approval is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the required immigration status, in one to three words.

questions.title: Which party will receive the largest share of the vote in Berlin's 2026 state election?
questions.background: Berlin is both a city and a German federal state. Its state election determines the composition of its parliament.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Results published by Berlin's election authority or reliable contemporaneous reporting of those results. Resolution : Resolve to the party receiving the highest statewide vote share in Berlin's 2026 state election. Subsequent coalition negotiations and the selection of the mayor do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The party's name or its standard abbreviation.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will be the first to settle its lawsuit against TikTok over youth-safety claims?
questions.background: TikTok faces lawsuits from U.S. states alleging that its platform harms young users and misleads consumers about its safety protections.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements from state attorneys general, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the U.S. state that reaches the first publicly announced settlement agreement with TikTok resolving a state lawsuit over youth safety and allegedly misleading safety claims. The agreement must be announced by September 30, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will ask a court to halt further development of ChatGPT over safety concerns in September 2026?
questions.background: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s conversational AI service. State authorities can seek court orders restricting products they allege pose risks to consumers.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official state court filings or announcements by state authorities, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Qualifying Event : During September 2026, a U.S. state formally asks a court to stop OpenAI from further developing ChatGPT until safety safeguards are established. The request itself resolves the question; the court need not grant it. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state making the request.

questions.title: Which court, if any, will grant Christa Pike a stay on the day of her scheduled September 30, 2026 execution?
questions.background: Christa Pike is on Tennessee's death row for the 1995 killing of Colleen Slemmer.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth: Use the court's order or contemporaneous reporting to identify the court. Resolution Date: Resolve to the court that grants a stay of Pike's execution on September 30, 2026, before her scheduled execution time that day. Accepted Answer Format: Answer with its commonly used short name.
